percentile_method: p95 nearest-rank; median is arithmetic midpoint for even sample counts

graph_sources.role: graph aggregate, not individual graph-node kernel

graph_visibility.reason: No validated graph-node membership/completeness relation; kernel and graph sums are not a coverage ratio.

warnings: Kernel durations are summed activity time, not elapsed latency, utilization, or official throughput; overlapping streams may overlap.
Sources are reported separately and are not summed globally: source tables may describe overlapping or mirrored activity.
Launch grid/block are not tensor M/N/K; tensor shape and process names are unknown unless explicitly present/resolved.
Kernel rows do not establish complete CUDA graph-node visibility. Graph membership and missing graph-internal kernels remain unproven.
Graph aggregate durations are separate from kernel activity; do not interpret the external-kernel percentages as graph-internal GEMM/attention shares.
